spans.s:
n. (-दं)
The anus.
E.
गुद to play, affix क.

m. (-लः)
Piles.
E.
गुद the anus, कील a pin or bolt; also with कन् added गुदकीलक.

m. (-हः)
Constipation, flatulence, &c.
E.
गुद the anus, and ग्रह what takes or affects.

m. (-शः)
Prolapsus ani.
E.
गुद, and भ्रंश loss.

m. (-रः)
Piles.
E.
गुद the anus, and अङ्कुर a sprout.

r. 10th cl. (इ) गुद्रि (गुंद्रयति)
To lie, to speak falsely.
